title: 🔥 BIBLICAL LOVE HAS WISDOM – WHY JESUS SAID TO LOVE ENEMIES BUT WARNED ABOUT DOGS & SWINE!
paragraphs:
🔥 BIBLICAL LOVE HAS WISDOM – WHY JESUS SAID TO LOVE ENEMIES BUT WARNED ABOUT DOGS & SWINE!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, Jesus commanded us to love our enemies, but He also warned about not throwing pearls to swine. How do we love others while being wise about who we trust?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians struggle to understand the balance between love and discernment. The Bible commands us to love even those who hate us, but it also warns us not to waste God’s truth on those who mock and reject it. So how do we obey both?

📖 Matthew 5:44 (KJV)
"But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you."

📖 Matthew 7:6 (KJV)
"Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you."

🚨 THE SHOCKING TRUTH:
✔️ God calls us to love our enemies—but He does NOT call us to be foolish!
✔️ We must forgive, but we must also protect what is holy!
✔️ Loving others does not mean tolerating abuse or continually sharing truth with those who mock it!
🔥 TRUE BIBLICAL LOVE REQUIRES DISCERNMENT!
💡 QUESTION: Are you loving your enemies with wisdom, or are you casting pearls before swine?
THE COMMAND TO LOVE – WHY JESUS CALLS US TO LOVE OUR ENEMIES!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why would Jesus command us to love our enemies? Doesn’t that go against human nature?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Human nature tells us to hate those who hurt us, seek revenge, and hold grudges. But Jesus commands us to love, bless, and pray for our enemies! Why? Because our love is a reflection of God’s love for us!

📖 Matthew 5:44-45 (KJV)
"But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you; That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven."
🚨 WHY DOES JESUS COMMAND US TO LOVE OUR ENEMIES?

1️⃣ BECAUSE GOD FIRST LOVED US!
🔥 We were once enemies of God, yet He showed us mercy!
📖 Romans 5:8 (KJV) – "But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us."
✔️ If God loved us when we were sinners, how can we refuse to love others?

2️⃣ BECAUSE LOVE IS STRONGER THAN HATE!
🔥 Hatred destroys, but love transforms hearts!
📖 Proverbs 25:21-22 (KJV) – "If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee."
✔️ Loving your enemies convicts them—hatred only feeds the cycle of sin!

3️⃣ BECAUSE OUR LOVE REFLECTS THE CHARACTER OF GOD!
🔥 We are called to be different from the world!
📖 Luke 6:35 (KJV) – "But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest."
✔️ Loving those who hate us proves we belong to Christ!
🔥 TRUE CHRISTIANS LOVE DIFFERENTLY—OUR LOVE IS SUPERNATURAL!
💡 QUESTION: Are you loving like Christ, or are you still holding on to hatred?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s break down Matthew 7:6—why Jesus warned us NOT to cast pearls before swine!
THE WARNING OF MATTHEW 7:6 – WHY JESUS SAID NOT TO CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if we are supposed to love our enemies, why did Jesus warn us not to cast pearls before swine? Doesn’t that seem contradictory?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers misunderstand Matthew 7:6 and think that loving others means endlessly giving time, energy, and wisdom to those who reject God’s truth. But Jesus gave us a strong warning: Not everyone will appreciate the truth, and some will even turn and attack us!

📖 Matthew 7:6 (KJV)
"Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS WARNING MEAN?

1️⃣ NOT EVERYONE VALUES GOD’S TRUTH!
🔥 Some people mock the Gospel, reject wisdom, and have no respect for biblical truth.
📖 Proverbs 23:9 (KJV) – "Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words."
✔️ If someone continuously rejects God’s truth, we are not called to force it on them!

2️⃣ SOME WILL TRAMPLE ON HOLY THINGS!
🔥 Swine were considered unclean animals in Jewish culture—Jesus used them as a symbol of those who have no regard for God’s wisdom!
📖 2 Peter 2:22 (KJV) – "The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire."
✔️ Some people will pretend to change, but in reality, they return to their sin!

3️⃣ THE ENEMY USES MOCKERS TO WEAR YOU DOWN!
🔥 Not everyone who argues with you is looking for the truth—some just want to attack your faith!
📖 Proverbs 9:7-8 (KJV) – "He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame... Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee."
✔️ We must discern when to walk away from fruitless debates!
🔥 LOVING YOUR ENEMIES DOES NOT MEAN GIVING GOD’S TRUTH TO THOSE WHO MOCK IT!
💡 QUESTION: Are you wisely sharing the Gospel, or are you casting pearls before swine?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s reveal how to love wisely—showing mercy while guarding what is holy!
HOW TO LOVE WISELY – SHOWING MERCY WHILE GUARDING WHAT IS HOLY!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how do we love our enemies without being taken advantage of? How do we show mercy but also protect what is holy?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians struggle with the balance between love and discernment. Jesus calls us to forgive, pray for, and do good to our enemies—but He also warns us not to waste our time, energy, and wisdom on those who will reject and mock it.

📖 Colossians 4:5-6 (KJV)
"Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time. Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man."
🚨 HERE'S HOW TO LOVE WISELY WITHOUT COMPROMISING TRUTH!

1️⃣ FORGIVE, BUT DON'T FORCE!
🔥 We must release hatred, but we are not required to force relationships with those who reject us!
📖 Romans 12:18 (KJV) – "If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men."
✔️ Forgiveness is required, but reconciliation depends on the other person’s willingness to change!

2️⃣ PRAY FOR THEM, BUT DON’T WASTE ENDLESS TIME ON MOCKERS!
🔥 Loving someone doesn’t mean letting them drag you into pointless debates.
📖 Titus 3:10 (KJV) – "A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject."
✔️ If someone repeatedly rejects God’s truth, it’s okay to walk away and keep praying for them from a distance!

3️⃣ DO GOOD, BUT SET BOUNDARIES!
🔥 Jesus loved sinners, but He didn’t let them manipulate Him!
📖 Matthew 10:16 (KJV) – "Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves."
✔️ Be kind, but don’t let people abuse your kindness!
🔥 LOVING WISELY MEANS BALANCING MERCY WITH DISCERNMENT!
💡 QUESTION: Are you practicing wise, biblical love, or are you allowing people to trample on your faith?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s issue a final challenge—Will you commit to loving biblically, with both wisdom and compassion?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU COMMIT TO LOVING BIBLICALLY, WITH BOTH WISDOM AND COMPASSION?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know God’s balance between love and discernment, the question is: Will you live by His standard, or will you let emotions control your actions?

📖 2 Timothy 1:7 (KJV)
"For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind."

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Will you love your enemies, bless those who curse you, and reflect the heart of Christ?
✔️ Will you walk in wisdom, refusing to waste time on those who reject God’s truth?
✔️ Will you trust that God’s way of love is stronger than hate, but also wise enough to set boundaries?
🔥 REAL LOVE IS BIBLICAL LOVE—FULL OF GRACE, BUT ALSO FULL OF TRUTH!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to follow Jesus' command to love wisely, or will you continue to struggle with worldly emotions?

🚨 MANY CHRISTIANS STRUGGLE WITH THIS—DON’T IGNORE JESUS’ WARNING!
📖 James 1:22 (KJV)
"But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves."

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Ignore this truth and let your emotions lead to frustration, wasted time, and broken relationships.
✔️ Commit to walking in biblical love, forgiving enemies while using discernment!
🔥 LOVING WISELY IS NOT OPTIONAL—IT’S A COMMAND FROM JESUS!

Give me the strength to forgive, but also the wisdom to know when to walk away. Let my life reflect the balance of grace and truth, just as Jesus showed us.
